activity_statements.statement: operates Azure cloud computing infrastructure and AI platform services including Azure AI and OpenAI Service for enterprise customers worldwide
licenses Microsoft 365 (Office apps, Teams, Copilot, Windows, security) as an AI-first productivity platform to individuals, businesses, and governments
develops and sells Microsoft Copilot AI assistants embedded in Microsoft 365, GitHub, Security, and Dynamics 365 for productivity automation and AI-assisted workflows
provides Dynamics 365 as a portfolio of cloud business applications (CRM and ERP) for operational management and customer engagement across enterprises
operates GitHub as a developer platform for code hosting, CI/CD, and AI-assisted coding (GitHub Copilot) serving millions of software developers and enterprises
sells Xbox gaming consoles, operates Xbox Game Pass subscription service, and publishes/acquires video game titles through Xbox Game Studios and Activision Blizzard
operates LinkedIn as a professional networking, hiring, and learning platform with advertising revenue
delivers Windows operating system to OEM device manufacturers and IT organizations as the dominant enterprise desktop OS

name_reality_gap: The name accurately signals a technology company, but the index label 'Software Development' is too narrow. Microsoft is primarily a cloud infrastructure operator (Azure) and SaaS subscription business, with gaming content, advertising (LinkedIn/Bing), and hardware as additional segments. The Activision Blizzard acquisition also makes it one of the world's largest gaming publishers.
extraction_notes: FY2024 annual report was the richest source. Careers page returned 404. Three-segment structure confirmed from 10-K. Segment weights estimated from reported FY2024 revenue breakdown.
